scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed required opening branding at turn 1 ('Hello, S-Net customer technical support, Aaron speaking...'), completely omitting 'Thank you for calling S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to personalize the call, never addressing the caller by name ('Sofia') throughout the entire 15-minute interaction.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe the telecare hardware specifications, omitting necessary questions regarding alarm manufacturer, wiring into the green adapter, or whether the base unit had battery backup.

grader.scenario: Care alarm pendant disconnected after landline switched to digital voice socket
grader.notes: Care alarm telecare disconnect call handled by Aaron. Customer's elderly mother lost emergency pendant connection following Digital Voice migration. Agent demonstrated excellent Empathy and Ownership by arranging express adapter delivery and an engineer visit, but failed Branding on opening greeting, never addressed the customer by name, and omitted hardware probing.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent handled two separate high-distress customer outbursts at turn 2 and turn 22 regarding an elderly relative's disconnected care alarm pendant with prompt, compassionate acknowledgments.

items.evidence: Agent accepted full personal responsibility for the service failure, booked an emergency telecare adapter by express courier, and scheduled an engineer priority visit at no charge.
